entries.inspected_hypotheses: Finite nonempty uniform sample space; arbitrary real function; positive tail threshold.
entries.conclusion: Uniform tail probability bounded by uniform variance divided by threshold squared.
entries.use: Proof pattern for converting a second-moment calculation into a tail inequality. Its finite-uniform probability definitions do not cover arbitrary iid real errors, and its SAT-specific variance bounds are not M-estimator bounds.

entries.inspected_hypotheses: Prefix projection of a finite product of probability measures; later cap theorem uses random Gaussian design, sphere-prior noiseless observations, finite learner states and dimension restrictions.
entries.use: Prefix projection is an applicable product-measure marginalization pattern. The named Gaussian-regression transfer theorem is not noisy deterministic-design regression and cannot establish replication consistency.

entries.inspected_hypotheses: C2 potential, positive Hessian lower bound on the fiber coordinates, invariance in the designated parameter-axis direction, and a linear statistic controlled by coordinateSquare. The conclusion is variance for a normalized exp(-V) Gibbs density on a fiber measure.
entries.use: Hessian linear-composition proof is a reusable calculus pattern. The Gibbs variance theorem does not describe the sampling law of an M-estimator. It also retains global lower curvature and therefore does not remove the LAD/Huber obstruction.

entries.inspected_hypotheses: Explicit finite tropical optimization state, forced substitutions, feasible output, and an explicit strictly better feasible point.
entries.use: An exact witness-verification pattern only. No stochastic consistency or asymptotic inference transfers from this finite tropical counterexample.

entries.inspected_hypotheses: Finite-dimensional real normed space; finite convex functions on all of the space; functions nonnegative everywhere; deterministic pointwise convergence at every point; compact target set.
entries.proof_dependencies_read: The proof forms the pointwise supremum of the sequence, proves it finite convex and continuous, obtains local Lipschitz bounds from convexity plus a local absolute bound, and applies equicontinuity with compactness to upgrade pointwise to uniform convergence.
entries.use: Genuinely relevant to Section 3 of regular-bounded-score-derivation.md: objective convergence must precede argmin convergence. Our signed contrasts do not directly satisfy the nonnegativity hypothesis, and convergence in distribution on a dense set is not this theorem's deterministic every-point premise. The separate score/nonnegative-remainder decomposition and written dense-convex/Skorokhod argument retain those missing steps explicitly; no direct application is claimed.

entries.inspected_hypotheses: Finite sum in an ordered semiring, with every summand nonnegative.
entries.use: Applicable to the finite persistent-row quantities |z_j't|: sum |z_j't|^2 <= (sum |z_j't|)^2. This is the finite-design step converting frame energy into linear coercivity in the proposed Gaussian LAD/Huber extension.
entries.direct_import: See the final Lean source/import receipt; this audit alone does not assert any new module compiled.

trust_boundary: These are inspected source statements and proof patterns, not replayed OAI theorem claims. No Comparator or nanoda acceptance is claimed.
